level_title: The Grandmaster Trial: Lord SegFault, The Null Sovereign

questions.title: Stage I • Phase 1: Shattering the Inverted Null Barrier (Data Types & Type Checking)
questions.prompt: [STAGE I: THE OBSIDIAN THRONE] Lord SegFault distorts reality by scrambling data types! Which Python built-in function reliably verifies if 'shield_energy' is an integer before casting your spell?
questions.hint: General NullByte's voice echoes: 'Use Python's built-in isinstance(var, type) to safely check variable types!'
questions.explanation: Barrier pierced! 'isinstance(shield_energy, int)' evaluates to True because 950 is an integer, safely triggering your spell without runtime errors!

questions.title: Stage I • Phase 2: Princess Ada's Decryption Key (Functions & Return Conduits)
questions.prompt: [STAGE I: THE STASIS PRISM] Princess Ada's cipher requires a pure function that multiplies the 5 General Keystones by 2. Fill in the missing return keyword to send the calculated key to the barrier lock!
questions.code_snippet:
def decrypt_stasis_prism(keystones):
    magic_power = keystones * 2
    ____ magic_power

key = decrypt_stasis_prism(5)
questions.hint: General Lambda-Prime whispers: 'A function must use the return keyword to deliver its output back to the caller!'
questions.explanation: Cipher decoded! The 'return magic_power' statement passes 10 back to 'key', cracking the first layer of Princess Ada's stasis prism!

questions.title: Stage II • Phase 3: [BUG HUNT] Defusing SegFault's Infinite Loop Trap!
questions.prompt: [STAGE II: THE INFINITE CHASM] Lord SegFault attempts to trap your consciousness in an endless loop! Click the ONE line that fails to decrement the timer, causing the loop to run forever!
questions.code_snippet:
# BUG HUNT: Spot the fatal flaw in this countdown loop!
countdown = 5
while countdown > 0:
    print('Purifying glitch...')
    countdown + 1    # <-- Bug! Doesn't subtract or reassign!
launch_counter_strike()
questions.hint: General Chronos-If commands: 'To avoid an infinite loop, the counter must decrease towards 0 with -= 1 each iteration!'
questions.explanation: Infinite loop broken! 'countdown + 1' never updated the countdown variable. Changing it to 'countdown -= 1' allows the loop to exit safely after 5 iterations!

questions.title: Stage II • Phase 4: Slicing the Glitch Shards (List Slicing & Ordering)
questions.prompt: [STAGE II: THE GLITCH STORM] SegFault hurls a corrupted matrix list: ['error', 'corrupt', 'alpha', 'beta']. Which slice extracts only the two purified spells ['alpha', 'beta']?
questions.hint: General Vektor-Zero advises: 'Python list indexing starts at 0! Elements at index 2 and 3 are extracted with [2:]!'
questions.explanation: Precision extraction! 'spells[2:]' takes elements from index 2 to the end, yielding ['alpha', 'beta'] and blasting away the glitch residue!

questions.title: Stage III • Phase 5: Assembling the Grandmaster Compiler (Syntax Ordering)
questions.prompt: [STAGE III: THE GENERALS' UNIFICATION] Lord SegFault unleashes his ultimate form! Arrange the code blocks in proper order to iterate through all 5 General Keystones, calculate the total power, and invoke the Royal Cleansing Spell!
questions.hint: Master PyWizard advises: 'Initialize the list and accumulator first, run the loop with indented addition, then check the total with if!'
questions.explanation: Fivefold resonance! The keystones accumulate to 1000 power, triggering the royal cleansing spell and exposing Lord SegFault's core!

questions.title: Stage III • Phase 6: The Final Purge (Grandmaster Execution)
questions.prompt: [FINAL PHASE: THE PURGING STRIKE] Lord SegFault is vulnerable! Execute the final purge by passing True to the restore_princess argument!
questions.code_snippet:
# The ultimate command to save Princess Ada and restore Pythonia!
purge_lord_segfault(target="SegFault", restore_princess=____)
questions.hint: Adventurer Alex shouts: 'In Python, the boolean value must always be capitalized—choose True!'
questions.explanation: SAVIOR OF PYTHONIA! Lord SegFault is permanently purged from memory! Princess Ada's stasis prism shatters into golden light, and the realm of Pythonia is restored!
